svg.title: Model routing architecture
svg.desc: Requests such as intent classification, summarization, multi-step reasoning and sensitive data go through an AI gateway and router, which selects a small, general, reasoning or private model based on cost, latency and privacy, with a fallback provider.

text.font-family: 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: FROM INDIVIDUAL MODELS TO ORCHESTRATED SYSTEMS

text.font-family: Manrope, 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Route each task to the right model.
